_comment: SCALE2 (spec/rules/scale.md): JSON.stringify sites in packages/rendering and packages/core runtime src that produce a wire format, debug display, HOST4 clone, or Intl cache key — not a per-commit / per-render change signature. Each entry needs file, enclosing symbol, and a reason. Remove an entry in the same PR that deletes the last call in that symbol.
